result.title: Simulated joint response to the recorded command, SO-101 elbow servo
result.quantity: elbow/actual_q (rad) at its own sample instants
result.baseline: B0: actual = command held between samples (zero-order hold) + constant offset fitted on identification
result.model: MotionProof drive response: second-order position loop (wn, zeta) with velocity limit vmax driving the joint through a dead band b (the drive model's backlash), plus offset; simulated at 1 ms from the recorded command
result.acceptance: pooled validation RMSE(model) <= 0.6 x pooled validation RMSE(B0)

split.validation: every heldout trial in which the elbow command spans >= 0.1 rad
split.unused: heldout trials in which the elbow command spans < 0.1 rad (elbow not excited); all other train trials

result.scope: external system; says nothing about the MotionProof reference gearbox or user hardware
transformations: command held constant between its samples (zero-order hold)
simulation at 1 ms, linearly interpolated to the actual_q sample instants
only samples inside the command time span
